module

enum CombatPhase
  case Startup
  case Active
  case Recovery
  case Complete

record CombatPhaseTicks [r1]
  field startup [r1.f0]: number
  field active [r1.f1]: number
  field recovery [r1.f2]: number

record WeaponMove [r2]
  field damage [r2.f0]: number
  field range [r2.f1]: number
  field arc [r2.f2]: number
  field startupTicks [r2.f3]: number
  field activeTicks [r2.f4]: number
  field recoveryTicks [r2.f5]: number
  field knockback [r2.f6]: number
  field lunge [r2.f7]: number

func advanceCombatPhase(phase: CombatPhase) -> CombatPhase
entry:
  return match phase : CombatPhase { Startup => enum CombatPhase.Active | Active => enum CombatPhase.Recovery | Recovery => enum CombatPhase.Complete | Complete => enum CombatPhase.Complete }

func swordMove() -> WeaponMove
entry:
  return record-new [r2] { [r2.f0]: 1, [r2.f1]: 25, [r2.f2]: 2.72, [r2.f3]: 3, [r2.f4]: 5, [r2.f5]: 10, [r2.f6]: 1, [r2.f7]: 76 }

func disturbanceFalloff(distance: number, radius: number) -> number
locals:
  const normalized: number
entry:
  if (radius <= 0)
    return 0
  store normalized, (1 - (distance / radius))
  if (normalized <= 0)
    return 0
  return (normalized * normalized)
